protocol: All capacity/state/membership writers obey same group guard. Pending-only exact request ETag decides first terminal including cancellation. Count all Active physical/provisional rows; no availability filter creates capacity. Fresh typed group/count check before request commit; no group State/Capacity edits. Persist receipt result and Complete before matching-token release. Positive exact readback can reconcile unknown writes. Definite stopped prefix seals old token, persists Retryable then releases; next bounded same-intent attempt reuses keys and confirmed prefix. Unknown absence/partial readback never proves no outstanding write and cannot authorize lease steal. Fully committed positive readback may finish only receipt/release, never repeat domain mutations.
